note: Forest Preserves of Cook County campground in the Palos preserves at Willow Springs, 20 miles from downtown Chicago. 15 of the 26 RV/tent sites have 30/50-amp electric; the lakeside sites have none. Gravel pads 24-40 ft. Also cabins and walk-in tent sites; kayak rentals for campers (no private boats on the lake). --Claude
